title: 番台ディストリクト
subtitle: 架空オープンワールド ショート
style: Third-person open-world game cutscene look, live-action cinematic photorealism, shallow depth of field, steady game-camera motion, no anime, no illustration

world.name: Shirayu district
world.lock: Fictional old downtown district around the public bathhouse Shirayu: narrow shopping street with tiled shop fronts, potted plants, utility poles and wires, warm street lamps, and a brick boiler alley with a tall brick chimney behind the bathhouse

aki.lock: 28-year-old Japanese woman, short black bob, white cotton tenugui towel tied over her hair with a dark patterned hem, plain indigo cotton happi jacket over a dark shirt, dark work pants, rubber sandals, calm determined face, natural makeup

yoshida.name_ja: 理容ヨシダ 店主 吉田
yoshida.lock: Japanese man in his early 60s, neat grey side-parted hair, white mandarin-collar barber jacket with a small round crest on the chest, warm anxious face

props.tenugui: white cotton hand towels, folded in a neat stack
props.bicycle: black city bicycle with a front wire basket
props.truck: small white Japanese kei pickup truck with split cedar firewood stacked in the bed

fail.reason: 薪を積みすぎて軽トラが動かなかった

beats.place: Bathhouse entrance opening onto the sunny shopping street, morning
beats.camera: Over-the-shoulder third-person camera behind Aki at shoulder height, following her out of the doorway with a slight walking bob
beats.action: Aki pushes through the blue wave-pattern noren of the bathhouse holding a folded stack of white towels, steps onto the sunny shopping street, glances right, and walks off down the street
beats.sfx: Noren cloth brushing, rubber sandals on stone, a distant bicycle bell, quiet morning street ambience
beats.music: Low pulsing synth bass with a single taiko hit at the start; holds under the whole clip

hud.mission: 手ぬぐいを理容室へ返せ

beats.camera: Third-person camera behind and slightly above the bicycle, tracking forward smoothly
beats.action: Aki rides the black city bicycle down the shopping street at an easy pace with the towel stack in the front basket; shop curtains and potted plants slide past
beats.sfx: Bicycle chain whir, tires on asphalt, a shop radio far away, wind
beats.music: Low pulsing synth bass, a little faster; a rhythmic hi-hat joins

hud.mission: 手ぬぐいを理容室へ返せ

beats.place: Inside a small old barbershop with a leather chair, mirrors, and lace curtains; wood-panelled walls, a shelf of bottles, and the big mirror fill the whole background
beats.camera: Static medium two-shot at eye level, a very slow push-in
beats.action: Aki hands the folded white towels to Yoshida across the barber chair; he takes them with both hands and nods; Aki gives a small bow; both stay standing in the same spot

speech.line: てぬぐい、おかえししますね
speech.text: 手ぬぐい、お返ししますね

speech.line: おお、たすかる。まきも たのむよ
speech.text: おお、助かる。薪も頼むよ

beats.sfx: Quiet barbershop, a wall clock ticking, cloth rustle
beats.music: Soft warm pad, the bass rests

hud.mission: 手ぬぐいを理容室へ返せ

beats.place: Narrow wet alley with vending machines at dusk
beats.camera: Third-person camera behind Aki at the open driver door, holding still
beats.action: Aki climbs into the white kei truck and shuts the door; the headlights flick on; the truck stays parked with the firewood stacked in the bed
beats.sfx: Truck door thunk, small engine idling, vending machine hum, rain dripping
beats.music: Bass returns with a slow taiko pattern
